title: Garmin Forerunner 255 Smart Watch Gray ~A$218.39 (~US$154.29) with PayPal BNPL AU Stock Shipped @ Aussie Electron AliExpress
body:
Deal: Garmin Forerunner 255 Smart Watch Gray ~A$218.39 (~US$154.29) with PayPal BNPL AU Stock Shipped @ Aussie Electron AliExpress

[freedomofspeech] AUFS25 works too despite below the threshold…
[Captain Hindsight] Thx are there any 255s similar price? I have women’s wrists.
[Owgasm] Sydney marathon has motivated me to upgrade to a 265 (from a poop Apple Watch) the next time it’s on sale. Hopefully not too soon so the motivation goes away!
[addas] I’m in the same boat thinking of an upgrade. Out of interest did you get through a marathon without the watch dying? I reckon mine won’t last more than 3hrs of recording….
[teereb] Have you tried running it in under 3 hours?
[teereb] @NotReallyaMoneySaver: Fast, AND the whole thing is recorded.
[xelfer] my 965 lasts me about 3 weeks. I was on 90% at the start of sunday and after 5 hours tracking and then 2 more days im still at 55%. highly recommended!
[ShanoDD] Nice! I needed an upgrade for my 235. Thanks OP.
[EBC] Am I missing something? I have never used the pay later but I don't see "PayPal, pay later" as an option. I see PayPal. I see pay in installments.
Do I select PayPal and change it after I click to checkout (the button that takes you to PayPal to finalise)?
Showing $169 when I go to checkout with PayPal. I can select pay in 4 but still shows $169.
[ShanoDD] Yes I just went to checkout, selected the payment method as Paypal - and then the "Pay in 4" option appears on the Aliexpress page..
It appears if you click "change payment method"
[garnier001] I thought this was a George Foreman Grill
[rokufan] Price bumped up to US$196.23. Clear, what was your original price before codes?
[ShanoDD] The 'grey' one did yes, but they're all the same colour…. slate grey and grey are the same. Slate grey is still there for $14 more, still a bargain.
